critical_code_review_comments: services/entitlements.py entitlements(): manual/tier locks composed cleanly; invalid module names filtered via `if m in MODULES` — safe. is_grandfathered uses string compare on ISO timestamp which is correct for RFC-3339 UTC.

server.py _plan_module_guard: correctly reads X-Tenant-Slug for multi-tenant admins, skips super_admin role, decodes JWT locally without DB write. Uses `startswith(prefixes)` — beware future path collisions (e.g. /api/customers-suggested would match customers prefix). Consider a regex or exact-segment guard if new endpoints share a prefix.

routes/lead_gen.py _has_real_inbox: blocks empty/@miracurl.com and placeholder domains list; edit_lead only resets status→'drafted' when it was drafted/no_email/pending/approved/skipped/failed (keeps sent/replied intact) — behaviour matches spec.

routes/subscriptions.py update_plan: features/highlight persist through /api/public/plans via plan_overrides overlay; PUT price=20000 kept the price stable even when features/highlight were only diff — safe for QA reset.

PlanTierPanel.jsx: 'hq-module-access' parent DIV shares the 'hq-module-' prefix used for the checkbox testids — selector `[data-testid^="hq-module-"]` matches N+1 elements (23 checkboxes + 1 container). Rename container to `hq-module-grid` (or make checkbox testid distinct) to avoid brittle e2e counts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For SA login use POST /api/auth/login WITHOUT X-Tenant-Slug (adding it forces tenant scoping). CSRF token comes from csrf_token cookie and must go in X-CSRF-Token header for all writes. The 403 MODULE_LOCKED response has `detail` as a plain STRING ('MODULE_LOCKED'), NOT a dict — parse {detail, module} at top level. Mongo access: mongosh 'mongodb://localhost:27017/miracurl_db' (miracurl_db is the DB_NAME). Landing plan cards live under [data-testid=plan-<key>], with 'Best value' text ribbon rendered inline (no separate testid); to check highlight, assert 'Best value' substring. PlanTierPanel: the 'hq-module-access' wrapper testid overlaps with `hq-module-*` prefix in selectors — use exact `[data-testid^="hq-module-"][type="checkbox"]` if counting checkboxes. Lead email fix component nests a button inside another button (React hydration warning) — cosmetic but flagged to main agent.
